askKunPrompt.updateIntro: Please update the third-party Agent "{{agent}}" on this computer to its latest version.
askKunPrompt.localNewer: A newer copy is already on this computer: {{version}}
askKunPrompt.versionTooLow: Kun reports this version is too low to connect.
askKunPrompt.updateInstructions: Work out how it was installed from the path and installation source, then update it the same way (for example npm install -g, brew upgrade or the Agent's own update command). Tell me which commands you plan to run before running them, and ask before deleting or overwriting files or using sudo. If it is bundled with another app, tell me how to update that app instead. Afterwards run its version command to confirm, and remind me to go back to Settings → AI assistant → Agent connections → Version and click Check for updates.
askKunPrompt.instructions: Work out the cause from the log first and tell me which commands you plan to run. Ask before deleting or overwriting files or using sudo. After the fix, verify the command runs, and remind me to go back to Settings → AI assistant → Agent connections and click Retry detection.
